title: Nono AI Archive: dos-à-dos menu booklet that flips, folds and opens in 3D
note: Booklet motion inspo. Korean brand designer 노노아카이브 (Nono AI Archive, nonoaiarchive.com) posted on 2026-11-27 a menu-book interaction built with GPT, using a dos-à-dos binding where both sides are front covers; he suggests cafe or restaurant web menus could work this way. A white site titled DOS-À-DOS lets you pick Drink, Dinner, Dessert or Salad menus; each booklet tilts in 3D with a soft shadow, flips, unfolds accordion-style and opens to spreads of bold colour-blocked pages with illustrated food and clean menu type (e.g. 'MILK COFFEE / TEA', prices in KRW). 91 s video, no sound. Thumbnail is a frame from the video.
